phase2_findings.title: Unread deferred WAL segments cannot be archived after a restore failure
phase2_findings.observed_result: replay_all_with_report_guarded logged a failed deferred restore but returned success. confirm_replayed could then archive unread staged files.
phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Return an error on restore failure; normal replay continuation must remain blocked after that error.
phase2_findings.finite_acceptance: A deterministic EISDIR conflict must return an error, retain the unread segment and prevent archive confirmation. Removing only the fixture conflict must permit recovery.
phase2_findings.remaining_limit: The deterministic restore conflict covers staged-file handling. It does not establish recovery from every corruption, filesystem failure or unexpected replay policy.

phase2_findings.title: Tick rescue queue admission preserves an unapplied WAL barrier
phase2_findings.observed_result: Tick discard_pending sent WAL ranges to an independent rescue queue without marking them unapplied. A later normal ACK could advance past pending rescue before a crash.
phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Mark the WAL range unapplied before rescue queue admission and retain the barrier across unsuccessful persistence.
phase2_findings.finite_acceptance: Linux child: start with one already-drained WAL record, hold independent rescue before disk write, inject a later ACK, persist the watermark, kill with signal 9, and replay the exact pending identity.
phase2_findings.remaining_limit: The new process-kill fixture starts with already-drained WAL and injects the later ACK. It does not run the whole supervisor, QuestDB or a hardware power failure.

phase2_findings.title: Depth rescue queue admission preserves an unapplied WAL barrier
phase2_findings.observed_result: Depth discard_pending had the corresponding rescue queue and later-ACK overtaking risk.
phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Mark the range unapplied before rescue queue admission and retain it until persistence succeeds.
phase2_findings.finite_acceptance: Repeat the actual child-process SIGKILL case for depth and ticks. Compare replay metadata and payload, and state that initial WAL was already drained.
phase2_findings.remaining_limit: Queue admission is still not a disk acknowledgment. Conservative barriers may cause extra idempotent replay until confirmed recovery.

phase2_findings.title: Depth shed paths cannot silently advance past unpersisted WAL ranges
phase2_findings.observed_result: Depth shed branches in run_frame_drain and drain_main_feed_frame were missing an unapplied WAL barrier.
phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Record an unapplied range before a shed or refusal transition.
phase2_findings.finite_acceptance: Drive the actual depth branch with a known WAL range. A later successful range must not advance the applied watermark past the unresolved range.
phase2_findings.remaining_limit: A preserved unapplied range only helps while its raw WAL remains recoverable; unreceived or unwritten data is outside this claim.

phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Commit delivery bookkeeping only after HTTP 2xx plus a typed top-level JSON ok:true. Disable redirects and retry unacknowledged or partial delivery.

phase2_findings.title: Continuous frame readiness cannot starve due timers and shutdown
phase2_findings.observed_result: The biased select checked a continuously ready frame receiver before timer and shutdown arms, with no explicit finite service quantum.
phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Bound frame work and service due maintenance and shutdown while preserving event order.

phase2_findings.remaining_limit: Task fairness is not a hard deadline guarantee. Large frame processing, synchronous maintenance, OS scheduling and I/O still contribute to delay.

phase2_findings.planned_or_implemented_fix: Bound request, log scan and response bytes; return explicit truncation or typed failure and recover for subsequent requests.
phase2_findings.finite_acceptance: Test a sparse large log with limit 1, one oversized line, an oversized request followed by a valid one, and an oversized or chunked mock HTTP response. Assert byte bounds and truthful incomplete output.

Grep still has a 2,000,000-byte per-file cap without an aggregate cap; catalogs, output and waits remain separate.

phase2_findings.title: Hot reload retains a bounded latest value and ignores unrelated file changes
phase2_findings.observed_result: Hot reload used an unbounded channel and drained every queued configuration. Unrelated file changes triggered work. The trading pipeline has no current production spawn.

phase2_findings.finite_acceptance: Queue 10,000 valid updates without consuming them: retained versions stay bounded and newest wins. An unrelated edit must not reload; an invalid update must preserve valid state.
phase2_findings.remaining_limit: This is currently a latent library path. Variable configuration application and indicator-state rebuilding remain O(configuration size).

phase2_findings.remaining_limit: No new allocation or latency run closes this first-admission gap; declaring a cap does not remove the cold reserve cost.

phase2_findings.remaining_limit: The supported owner remains one writer. A public shared-reference API and expected hash performance do not imply arbitrary multiwriter or wait-free behavior.
